fields.title: Write the release runbook: build, sign, upload and verify the installers by hand
fields.description: No workflow builds or uploads installers (`release.yml` was deleted in e9bbf56a), so the Stage 8 release is a manual step. Write a runbook in `docs/governance/` for building the x64 and ARM64 installers with electron-builder, signing them if configured, uploading them to the GitHub release, and checking the `latest.yml` electron-updater reads for both architectures. Docs only.
fields.notes: Created 2026-10-22 by Blurby.Roadmap on Blurby.Brain's ruling (Rule 11 tier 1), from blurby-6b's ELECTRON-42-UPGRADE-1 finding. Stage 8 release gate (12): must exist before the batched owner smoke. Docs only, no CI rebuild. `TECHNICAL_REFERENCE.md:945` still describes the deleted release workflow.
